kjv: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? (KJV 58:1)
mine: Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods?
note: MT 'elem "silence" makes little sense; most read 'elim "gods" (the divine rulers condemned as in Ps 82), while the KJV takes it as "congregation" (perhaps from 'alam "bind together"); the psalm then rebukes heavenly, not human, judges. Context: you gods (rulers) (medium confidence). 58:2b 'your hands deal out violence on earth' addresses rulers who judge; compare Ps 82, where the 'gods' are judges condemned for injustice.
